subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should Copilot BYOK adopt the proposed unconditional 16 MiB body limit and 30-second read timeout as its permanent proxy contract?
rationale: The implementation defect is fixed cleanly, but repository evidence and the upstream SDK contract do not establish that these fixed limits preserve every currently supported BYOK request shape, so accepting the compatibility tradeoff requires owner intent.

options.title: Calibrate against SDK limits
options.body: Derive or document a ceiling that covers supported encoded text and multimodal requests, add boundary coverage, and then merge the guarded-reader implementation.

options.title: Accept the fixed contract
options.body: Merge the 16 MiB and 30-second limits as intentional fail-closed policy and own any oversized or slow-request compatibility impact.

recommendation.title: Calibrate against SDK limits
recommendation.body: Derive or document a ceiling that covers supported encoded text and multimodal requests, add boundary coverage, and then merge the guarded-reader implementation.
